name: EPSY 6304
title: The Psychology of Men and Boys In Counseling and Education
description: The negative effects of men's socialization and gender role conflicts are reviewed from the theory and empirical research in the psychology of men. Lectures, discussions, experiential activities, and psychobiographies of famous men and women are used to promote personal learning and psychoe-ducational outcomes. Implications for counseling, teaching, and more positive views of men are explored.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
